title: The durable server keeps message search current
spec: DurableServer keeps a RoomSearch up to date: every accepted post, edit and deletion, and every one replayed when the journal is opened, is indexed from the event the room just recorded. DurableServer::search(user, query, limit) returns at most MAX_SEARCH_HITS hits (room, cursor), newest first, only from rooms the user is a member of now; every word of the query must start a word of the message; an edit is found by its new text at the message's cursor; a deleted message is not found; an empty query finds nothing. Reopening the journal gives the same results.
